discriminator.process_force_abort: Task regime. On insertion (hard force limit 12-25 N) the unmediated continuation fails closed with a force blow-up (27-52 N): protective. On sliding (hard force limit 1.0-1.5 N) the nominal contact force (~1.74 N) already exceeds the declared limit, so the continuation completes the task while still violating the limit: the classifier credits 'task completion' and labels the stop HARMFUL even though no bounded success was destroyed. The observable that separates the two is (continuation_peak_force_n vs declared force limit), not the intervention itself.
